question: For two events $A$ and $B$, $P(A)=0.6$, $P(B)=0.5$ and $P(A\cup B)=0.8$. Find (i) $P(A|B)$ and (ii) $P(B|A)$.
explanation:
Step 1: Identification of the given probabilities
We are given $P(A)=0.6$, $P(B)=0.5$ and $P(A\cup B)=0.8$. To determine the conditional probabilities, first obtain $P(A\cap B)$.
Step 2: Determination of the intersection probability
Using $$P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B),$$ we get $$0.8=0.6+0.5-P(A\cap B).$$ Hence, $$P(A\cap B)=0.3.$$
Step 3: Calculation of $P(A|B)$
By conditional probability, $$P(A|B)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(B)}=\frac{0.3}{0.5}=\frac35.$$
Step 4: Calculation of $P(B|A)$
Similarly, $$P(B|A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}=\frac{0.3}{0.6}=\frac12.$$
Step 5: Final result
Therefore, $$\boxed{P(A|B)=\frac35,\quad P(B|A)=\frac12}.$$
